strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Spearphishing via a Service across OS Platforms

analytics.name: Analytic 0320
analytics.guidance: Inbound spearphishing attempts delivered via third-party services (e.g., Gmail, LinkedIn messages) leading to malicious file downloads or browser-initiated script execution. Defender view includes correlation of external service logins, unexpected file write operations, and suspicious descendant processes spawned from productivity or browser applications.

tuning.description: List of third-party services (e.g., Gmail, LinkedIn, Dropbox) relevant to the organization’s threat profile.
Process lineage and parent-child execution relationships considered abnormal (e.g., outlook.exe → powershell.exe).
Correlates file creation and outbound connection activity within a tunable time period after message receipt.

analytics.name: Analytic 0321
analytics.guidance: Use of non-enterprise email or messaging services in Thunderbird, Evolution, or browsers leading to suspicious file downloads and subsequent execution. Defender view includes browser-initiated downloads of unexpected content and shell or interpreter processes launched post-download.

tuning.description: Configured list of browsers or email clients to monitor (e.g., firefox, chromium, thunderbird).
Custom regex rules for suspicious URL patterns, file extensions, or encoded links.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of bash, python, or perl processes spawned by browser/email client

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Inbound messages from webmail services containing attachments or URLs

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Outbound traffic to domains/IPs not previously resolved, occurring shortly after attachment download or link click

analytics.name: Analytic 0322
analytics.guidance: Phishing attempts via iCloud Mail, Gmail, or social media apps accessed on macOS systems. Defender view includes Mail.app or Safari downloads of files followed by osascript, Terminal, or abnormal child process execution.

tuning.description: Flagging mismatched or self-signed certificates during outbound connections initiated after spearphishing messages.
Window of time between attachment download and subsequent suspicious execution.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Received messages containing embedded links or attachments from non-enterprise services

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Execution of osascript, bash, or Terminal initiated from Mail.app or Safari

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Suspicious outbound HTTPS requests to domains flagged as newly registered or untrusted after spearphishing message interaction
